I had many assessments in the past and nothing found just it is what it is - recurrent UTIs. I moved house and went to this GP surgery as I was about to travel abroad and asked for a stand-by prescription so I can take medication with me. Young arrogant GP said that she will not give any prescriptions and since I am going abroad it means she doesn’t have to do that at all and I can get my treatment abroad. She actually discriminated me she was rude. Shame it was a while ago and I do not remember her name. Well, I registered with other Gp practice the same day and got my prescription next day- no questions asked. All evidence with all my tests and assessments regarding my UTI are in my file (all medical history is available to GP). So I do not know what was an issue at  Colinton Medical Practice - perhaps an old fashioned angry GP lady who was rude and unprofessional.
